depiction.primary_object: open envelope with top flap raised

readings.meaning: open mail, read email, or inbox

ambiguity: Closely related to a closed envelope (which represents mail/email generally or unread mail); at very small sizes, the raised flap can make the outline resemble a small house.

reasoning: An open envelope with its flap raised is a universal symbol for mail, email, reading messages, and managing an inbox. It fits a very common family of everyday tasks (answering emails, sorting physical post, inbox zero, sending invitations), though it slightly overlaps with the standard closed envelope icon.
